description: This file appears to be a C++ source file implementing functionality for a 'DemuxerStreamFsFCC' class which manages stream control via filesystem-based communication, including setting/getting channel, seek position, trick play speed, and stream status. It includes helper functions for file I/O and data parsing, and references internal and external symbols related to demuxer streams.
